questions.prompt: Which ancient wonder stood on the island of Pharos?
questions.fact: It stood for around 1,600 years before earthquakes finally brought it down, outlasting every other wonder but the pyramids.

questions.prompt: What is the term for animals that maintain a stable internal temperature?
questions.fact: It costs enormously more food, which is why a lizard can live on a fraction of what a similar-sized mammal needs.

questions.prompt: What is the term for scoring three goals in one ice hockey game?
questions.fact: Fans traditionally throw hats onto the ice, and the arena staff collect them during the next stoppage.

questions.prompt: Which singer released the album Lemonade?
questions.fact: It was released with an hour-long film, and arrived with no advance announcement at all.

questions.prompt: Which country is the largest producer of cocoa beans?
questions.fact: It and Ghana together grow well over half the world's supply, almost all of it on smallholder farms.

questions.prompt: Which novel opens with the line Call me Jonah?
questions.fact: The opening deliberately echoes Moby-Dick, and the novel invents a religion built on admitted lies.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym DNS resolve?
questions.fact: There are thirteen root server addresses worldwide, though each is actually many machines answering to the same address.
